description: A contemporary rural retelling where a fed-up widower uses a hair trimmer, grease, and chimney soot to make his pushy housekeeper mistake herself for the devil—sparking a chain of bungled thefts, panicked prayer circles, and small-town rumors that spread faster than spotty mobile reception.
summary: A shaved, soot-smeared woman convinces a whole valley that the devil is loose after she loudly “helps” some thieves.
